character: a glossy red lobster, long whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug and pleased with himself

props: ONE scrubbed wooden table; ONE glass jar of yellow butter with a lid; ONE stack of coins; ONE lemon; furry mic bottom right

environment: a sunlit seaside kitchen: tall window, white tiles, hard sun

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
